name: bell
about: The Python service the router was first written for: pytest under a shared test lock, ruff and Pyright through a lint script, a rules file every worker reads, and golden snapshots no PR may change unless its contract says so. The run directory's bin/ holds its scripts (locked-commit.sh, pytest-limited.sh, bounded.sh, ci-lint-changed.sh), copied there by the coordinator before the first chain.
